segments.text: Think power is everything? Think again — the Swift leaves rivals in the dust without the big engine.
Just a 1.2-litre engine, but 82 PS and 111.7 Nm. Smart, not brute force.
And 25.75 kmpl mileage. Your wallet says thanks.
Priced ₹5.79 to ₹8.80 lakh, the ZXi is the sweet spot — LED projectors, 15-inch alloys, a 9-inch touchscreen. Most bang for your buck.
But rear AC vents? If your car skips those, are you even living?
Swift, or not so Swift? Tell us below — and follow for more.
